build_rnn_model: build an RnnModel instance with word_dict, item_dict, context_dict, count_dict, and args for end-to-end negotiation
run_forward_pass: run the RnnModel forward method with input tokens and context to get language and selection outputs
generate_sentence: generate a word-by-word sentence using the write method with language hidden state and context hidden state
score_sentence: score an existing sentence using the score_sent method with language hidden state and context hidden state
compute_selection_logits: compute selection logits for items using the forward_selection method with input embeddings and hidden states
